args.query: select column_name, table_name from information_schema.columns where table_schema='api' and table_name in ('application','status') order by 2,ordinal_position; select * from api.status;

out:
id|application
number|application
company_id|application
status_id|application
amount|application
revenue|application
description|application
expert|application
verdict|application
id|status
name|status
ord|status
20000|Черновик|1
20001|Подана|2
20002|На экспертизе|3
20003|Одобрена|4
20004|Отклонена|5

args.query: select a.number, c.name, a.id, (select string_agg(k.number||':'||coalesce(k.status,''),',') from api.contract k where k.application_id=a.id) from api.application a join api.company c on c.id=a.company_id where a.status_id=20003 order by 1;
